news_cards.title: Government Considering Relief for Farmers
bullets: Government considering relief for farmers who have paid crop insurance premiums as well as those who cannot take up sowing due to inadequate rainfall.
Minister Basavaraj Rayaraddy says the government is considering relief for farmers.
This decision is crucial for the welfare of farmers and the agricultural sector.

news_cards.title: Government to Transform Amaravati, Vizag, Tirupati into Mega Cities
bullets: Government to transform Amaravati, Vizag, and Tirupati into mega cities.
Minister Ponguru Narayana visits the stalls of CREDAI Tirupati Property Expo 2026.
This decision will boost economic growth and development in these regions.

news_cards.title: Tribals to Get Government Health Centre
bullets: Tribals atop Alleri hillock in Vellore to get government health centre.
This decision will improve healthcare facilities for tribal communities.
The government is committed to providing better healthcare services to all citizens.
